map.按亩耗油系数估算作业用油：油耗 = 作业面积 × 亩耗油（L/亩）。: Estimate the fuel for an operation from the per-mu coefficient: fuel = operated area x fuel per mu (L/mu).
map.按农机功率、负荷系数与柴油机比油耗估算小时油耗，结合作业时长算出总用油量，便于农: Estimates hourly fuel use from the machine power, load factor and diesel specific fuel consumption, then multiplies by the operating hours to get the total fuel, which helps with farm machinery cost accounting and refuelling plans.
map.按柴油机比油耗法估算：功率乘实际负荷系数得有效功率，再乘比油耗（g/kWh）得小: Estimated by the diesel specific fuel consumption method: multiply the power by the actual load factor to get the effective power, multiply that by the specific fuel consumption (g/kWh) to get the hourly fuel in grams, divide by 1000 to convert to kilograms, and divide by the fuel density (diesel is about 0.84 kg/L) to convert to litres. Multiplying by the operating hours gives the total fuel, and optionally converting at the fuel price gives the cost, for farm machinery cost accounting and refuelling planning.
